title: Generalized Fetch-To-Pose Living Plan
status_detail: This page summarizes current direction and evidence. It is route-owner UAT progress, not release or promotion evidence.

long_term_milestone.title: Planner-Gated Generalized Fetch-To-Pose v1
long_term_milestone.body: Deliver a no-shoot, robot-owned fetch behavior where the planner chooses the bounded route, Nav2 or recovery setup owns approach geometry where it has evidence, local fetch closes the line, and a bounded contact servo finishes only inside a measured delivery envelope.

architecture_direction.label: LLM / world-state planner routes
architecture_direction.body: Classify each scene as fetch_ready_local, nav2_reposition_first, scan_or_perceive_first, recovery_or_reaim, or ambiguous_or_unsafe_no_go before local fetch is judged.

architecture_direction.label: Nav2 / recovery / local fetch setup
architecture_direction.body: Use Nav2 and recovery setup to reach a forward-only contact-ready pose, then use local fetch only when the ball-target line, standoff, lateral error, yaw, and freshness gates are inside bounds.

architecture_direction.label: Bounded contact servo
architecture_direction.body: Advance into contact with limited forward authority, monitor ball motion and delivery radius, and report contact-quality watches separately from delivery success.

architecture_direction.label: Evidence monitor
architecture_direction.body: Keep geometry, model provenance, browser-safe videos, keyframe sheets, first-contact quality, and promotion_evidence status visible in every evidence package.

evidence_ladder.label: Artifact floor
evidence_ladder.body: geometry_consistency.pass, calibrated_golf_ball provenance, golf_ball_delivery_zone_marker, and same-session onboard plus context video.

evidence_ladder.label: Planner handoff gate
evidence_ladder.body: Mixed scenes must route correctly with zero wrong fetch dispatches before executable local-fetch outcomes count.

evidence_ladder.label: Route-owner visual UAT
evidence_ladder.body: Executable fetch_ready_local, nav2_reposition_first, and recovery_or_reaim routes need browser-watchable packages and sequence review.

evidence_ladder.label: Broad randomized route-owner batches
evidence_ladder.body: Seeded route-quality batches measure breadth and surface setup/contact watches while keeping promotion_evidence false.

evidence_ladder.label: Canonical promotion ladder
evidence_ladder.body: Saved-layout repeatability and seeded-random promotion gates remain the milestone proof after route-owner quality stabilizes.

recent_video_proof.title: Seed 20260620 scene10 recovery miss
recent_video_proof.summary: Session 20260603T210328421082Z is the current negative proof row from the active batch.

primary_video.label: Scene10 onboard raw camera browser MP4

recent_video_proof.proves: The failure is real and useful: calibrated geometry and model provenance are valid, Nav2 reposition succeeded, and the ball missed the 0.300m delivery radius with closest approach about 0.574m. The contact metrics flag first-contact yaw and trajectory-angle error, matching the visual miss pattern.
recent_video_proof.limits: This is a controller-stage gap, not a page or artifact issue. It should feed route-supervisor and recovery-contact work after the full batch completes, rather than being treated as a promotion result.

recent_video_proof.title: Seed 20260620 scene21 terminal miss
recent_video_proof.summary: Session 20260603T211625725564Z shows a fetch_ready_local row with clean first contact that still stops short of the delivery circle.

primary_video.label: Scene21 onboard raw camera browser MP4

recent_video_proof.proves: The broad random surface is finding a real terminal-arrival gap: first-contact quality passed, trajectory-angle error was low, stable contact approach passed, and the ball still missed the 0.300m delivery radius with closest approach about 0.392m.
recent_video_proof.limits: This is not a setup-routing failure. It points at terminal correction or delivery-energy shaping inside the local fetch stage, and it should be handled after the full batch confirms how often this pattern appears.

watch_areas.label: Recovery contact quality
watch_areas.body: Seed18 shows recovery cases that deliver inside contract while still flagging ball_lateral_knock_away, contact_trajectory_angle_error, or first-contact yaw/lateral watches.

watch_areas.label: Yaw and lateral setup quality
watch_areas.body: Current seed20260619 executable rows are clean after contact-ready-aware metric gating. Keep yaw/lateral setup under watch in the next broad seed and canonical promotion reruns.

watch_areas.label: Visual keyframe review
watch_areas.body: Continue inspecting start/setup, pre-contact, first contact, mid-push or coast, terminal arrival, and final rest. Raw onboard camera review remains the primary sanity check, with topdown/world-stream as geometry context.

next_steps: Use seed20260619 metric-gated evidence as the current broad visual baseline for route-owner UAT.
Run the next broad generated seed with the contact-ready-aware metric in place, then compare watches against seed20260619.
Keep sequence review onboard-first: start/setup, pre-contact, first contact, mid-push or coast, terminal arrival, and final rest.
Prioritize new control work only when a watch reproduces visually and geometrically across fresh evidence.
Rerun canonical saved layouts and seeded-random promotion gates after route-owner quality stays clean across multiple broad batches.
